body:
Eager-closure measurement, promised in the PR body — the build finished once load eased:

```
$ node scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs
✅ Console eager closure is 3186.3 KB gzipped across 50 of 518 chunks (budget: 3191.4 KB, headroom: 5.1 KB).
✅ Per-chunk eager budgets (4 chunks weighed):
  ✅ vendor-objectstack       926.2 KB / 944.3 KB ceiling (headroom 18.2 KB)
  ✅ i18n-locales             438.7 KB / 444.3 KB ceiling (headroom 5.6 KB)
  ✅ ui-components            383.5 KB / 389.6 KB ceiling (headroom 6.2 KB)
  ✅ framework                 68.5 KB / 69.3 KB ceiling (headroom 0.8 KB)
```

**Passes.** The reasoning in the PR body held: the four lazily-loaded plugins (`plugin-kanban`/`plugin-tree`/`plugin-map`/`plugin-timeline`) contribute nothing to the eager closure regardless of the new dependency edge, and `plugin-list`/`app-shell` already ship `@object-ui/permissions` through other call sites — this diff adds no new eager-closure edge, only a few bytes of call-site code.

⚠️ Headroom is thin in general on this build (5.1 KB aggregate, 0.8 KB on the `framework` chunk) — that is the state of the budget on `main` plus this diff, not something this PR moved meaningfully; I did not diff against a pre-change build to isolate this PR's own delta in bytes, since the qualitative reasoning (no new dependency edge on either eager package) already accounts for why it's near-zero. Flagging the thinness for whoever reviews next, not as a defect of this PR.

No split needed — one PR stands.
